class.name: VehicleMasterController
class.brief_description: The driver's master controller of a vehicle.
class.description: The positions of the main and second controller and how fast they step - the controller part of the FIZ [code]Cntrl.[/code] section. Every vehicle with that section has one, with an engine or without: a control car reverses and steps its own controller.

members.member: [code]Cntrl.CoupledCtrl[/code]: the second controller continues the main one.
[code]Cntrl.DirChangeMaxPos[/code]: the highest main position the reverser may be moved at.
[code]Cntrl.MCPN[/code]: without positions the vehicle has no reverser and no line breaker to close.
[code]Cntrl.SCDDelay[/code] [s]; the FIZ importer gives it [member step_delay] when absent.
